column2: [intro]
I feel so strange in my skin
When my seams show, it makes my head spin
I hide my flaws, it always stings a bit
But I am who I am, whether known or hid
Hidden under the seams, I am a mystery
But deep down, I'm me, with fleeting frailty
People judge me, criticize, but I don't care
I'm free, I'm me, and that, I declare
In this perfect world, I'm a bit offbeat
I prefer little sparks of madness, the hidden sides, sweet
Life's too short to be taken seriously
So I dance, I laugh, and I let go freely
Hidden under the seams, I am a mystery
But deep down, I'm me, with fleeting frailty
People judge me, criticize, but I don't mind
I'm free, I'm me, that's my wealth, refined
[ solo ]
So let me shine, despite the visible seams
I'm a star, unique in this wild galaxy, it seems
And if you want to join me, in this world of glee
Come along, hide under your own sketched seams with me
[ outro ]
